note: Plain-words list of changes, newest first. Add an entry with every change (shown in the app: tap the version at the bottom of the map).

versions.title: Notices, videos, working here
items: 📝 Leaving a job without an after photo? The helper now gives you one-tap reasons (No access, Tenant refused, Completed by others) and saves it on the job after your yes.
⏰ When a job is taking much longer than usual, the helper offers to text the next tenant on today's route that you're running late, with your new time. You tap send.
🗣 Tuck the chat to the side (⇥) and keep asking: the type box comes back, and short answers show right in the little bubble without covering the map. Tap the bubble to open the chat.

🗺 Today's route learns how long things really take: a building you've been to gets the time it took last time, and other jobs get your usual time for that kind of work ("⏱ 80 min here"), so the day's times are closer to real.

🌐 When a tenant texts back in Spanish, Chinese or Russian, the app remembers it: your next texts to them are written in their language, with the English underneath so you know what it says. Change it with the 🌐 Their language buttons on the text.
☎️ What HPD said on your last call shows right on the notice (tell the helper "HPD said ..." to save it).
📷 Snap a receipt on a job card and the total and store fill in by themselves; check it and tap Add.

🧾 Costs on every job card: type or say what you spent ("spent 45 at Home Depot"), add the receipt photo; it shows what's spent and what's left of the award. Receipts stay on the phone, never sent to HPD.
🏢 Job cards show the other jobs at the same building since 2024: when, which apartment, the money and how it ended (no access, completed, paid).
💻 On the computer the map says "no GPS · phone has you at" the job you're working, instead of a location error; "jobs need a check" is behind the ✉ side button.
✉️ Email from the app: on a job card tap "Email Lewis about this job" (or ✉ side button -> Email HPD), tap a ready line, check, Send. Only to HPD addresses.
🎥 Videos now go up to Drive on mobile data too (on Android they stopped whenever the phone was on cellular).
👁 "See the before items" on the job card shows every saved photo and video, and whether it's in Drive yet.
📋 Every notice shows the job number, address, work and HPD's status; sent ones are folded away, the emails behind a tap.
🚨 Lewis · ERP and 🏛 Gafur · AEP each have their own map of what's still to send; 📦 sent ones are on the archive map.
📅 Saving an appointment emails Lewis (ERP) or Gafur (AEP) 15 seconds later, with Undo.
📍 At a job it asks "Have you arrived?"; Yes opens HPD's work order, scrolls to the work and reads it out loud.
🔨 The job you're working at shows on the map, on the phone and the computer, with the time on site; the time is kept on the job.
✉ Updates and Claude's progress are behind one small button on the right edge; 🧹 old jobs with nothing on file are off the map.

versions.title: On the way, photos, your words
items: 🚗 "On my way" texts now say when you'll be there ("around 2:40 PM"), so the tenant knows even if they read it later.
📸 The paperwork card warns when before or after photos are missing, with a button to go take them first.
📝 On a partial job, what you told the helper fills "What work was completed?" on the invoice, for you to check.

versions.title: Bid page reads slower
items: 🧾 On a bid's work description page, the read-along moves slower, stops where the work ends (not HPD's standard notes), and goes back to the start of the work.
🗂 Tell the helper a job is done: it says the affidavit and invoice are next, with a button to check them now.
🧠 The morning brief asks about what you said you'd do yesterday ("Yesterday you said you'd call the tenant. Did that get done?").
🔕 Quiet hours: from 9 PM to 7 AM alerts show on the screen without sound, voice or buzz (unless you're working the notices).

versions.title: The helper knows where you are and keeps you posted
items: 📍 At a job, say "what job is this" or "this job": the helper knows which job you're standing at. No number needed.
📱 Driving: a tenant's text is read to you and the helper listens for your answer ("tell her we'll be there at 10"). It reads it back and sends only after your yes.
📊 Friday at 5: your week in a few words (jobs closed, work done, bids won, first thing next week).

versions.title: It learns your words and follows up
items: 👂 Teach the helper your own words: "when I say close it, I mean send the affidavit". Next time "close it" just does it. "Forget close it" undoes it.
👂 When you pick from "Did you mean…?", it remembers, so it won't ask the same thing again.
🔁 Say "I'll call the tenant after lunch" and the helper brings it up at 1:30 by itself.
🚚 In the truck: when road noise garbles your words, the helper asks you to say it again (or tap what it heard) instead of guessing.

versions.title: A more real face and voice
items: 🙂 In the helper's 🎨 pick one of 3 real-looking faces (Natural, Studio, Warm), or keep the drawn one. It still blinks and its lips follow the words.
🎙 The 🎨 shows the 3 best voices on your phone: tap ▶ Hear to listen, then "Use this voice". Natural voices now speak a little slower.

versions.title: It remembers our talk
items: 🧠 The helper keeps today's talk on your phone: ask "what did we talk about", "what did I say about Main Street", "say that again" or "the job before".
🧠 The day so far shows "Today we talked about …" with the jobs.

versions.title: Check every notice
items: 🔎 Notices -> "Check every notice from my email" (or say "check every notice"): each job in one line: already sent (when, which PDF; don't send again), not sent yet, HPD found a problem, or check first.
📤 A job whose paperwork already went to HPD (like ER01720, sent in the stop work email) no longer says call the tenant or needs a visit: it waits on HPD.
🔕 No more "urgent" out loud: notice deadlines are said only when you're working the notices.
📋 The ☀️ Today sheet now starts with the same three boxes as the chat: done today, what I told you, coming up.
🗣 It waits while you're still talking: a short pause after "call the tenant for…" no longer cuts you off.

versions.title: Do all, from the app
items: 😴 Say "not today" (or tap 😴 Not today under an item in 🔔 I told you): it leaves today's list and comes back in tomorrow's morning brief.
✅ "📋 Next on the plan" shows on the map with the next upgrades from the plan. One tap on ✅ Do all (or say "do all") and Claude builds them in order, then asks you about the next ones.
🗓 Say "plan my week": your open work on the next 7 days. Bids on their due day, appointments, notices on their deadline (late ones today), close-outs where there's room.
🌆 The evening wrap shows the same boxes as the day so far: done, still open, coming up. Said once.
🔁 One greeting across your phones: if the iPhone already said good morning, the laptop says "Hi again".

versions.title: Says it once
items: 🗣 The morning hello is said once a day. Tap the 🤖 again later and it says "Hi again" with what you got done, what's still open from what it told you, and the next thing. No repeats, and no "99 jobs to do".

📒 The day so far, in the chat: ✅ done today, 🔔 what I told you (✓ when done), ⏭ coming up (tomorrow's bids, this week's appointments, notices waiting on HPD). Tap 📒 or say "what did we do today" / "what's left".
🔔 A reminder is said once a day, not again and again.
➡️ It moves on by itself: when today's bids or the notices are done it says so once and offers the next part ("Notices next: 2 to send. Go?"). Say "go" or "ok" and it does it.
🧠 "It" means the job you were just talking about: "I already sent it", "read me that one": no "which job?" again.
🗣 Long answers: it says the first two sentences out loud; the rest is on the screen.

versions.title: Go through my notices
items: 🗂 Say "go through my notices": the helper takes you to each notice still to send, one by one (most urgent first). Each card says who sent it, what they ask, what your email shows (affidavit and invoice sent? when, which file, HPD's answer), the work and where (apartment / public hall), the tenant's name and phone, and what to do now, with one tap for each step.
✅ "Already sent / fixed" on every notice (two taps), or say "I already sent ER00272". It goes to Done on every phone; Undo is there.

📧 The board reads HPD's answer after your paperwork: "Received" closes it by itself; "the copy is blank" or "highlighted errors" puts it back to send with their words. A notice whose affidavit and invoice went out never says overdue.
🟢🔴 Sent / fixed notices are green, the rest red, with 🔥 on the 24 / 72-hour ones still to send. Picking Gafur opens her board right away.
✏️ Fixing paperwork you already sent keeps the original dates (work started / completed, attempts, refusal) locked 🔒. If HPD asked to change a date, tap "HPD asked to change a date".

📨 Bids: "next bid" stays on today's and stops when they're done ("tomorrow's bids" when you want them). The walk is slower: the city, the building, its photo, then HPD's page read along left to right.

versions.title: Tenant texts in their language
items: 💬 A tenant texts in Spanish, Chinese or Russian: the helper shows the whole text in English and offers an answer written in their language (with what it means in English). Nothing goes out until you say yes.

🧾 "What do I need today" now ends with a shopping list in the order you walk the store (paint, building materials, plumbing, electrical, hardware…), with a check box for each thing. Ticks stay for the day.
📝 After "what do I say to HPD", tell the helper what HPD said and it's kept on the job as "☎️ HPD call" with the date. Any time: "HPD said about ER07663 the inspection is Monday".

versions.title: Talk with the tenant both ways
items: 🔁 Say "translate" (or tap 🔁 Talk both ways on a job card): the tenant holds their button and speaks Spanish, Chinese or Russian and the helper says it in English; you hold English and it says it back in theirs, big on the screen too. You can also type.
☎️ HPD calling? Say "what do I say to HPD about" and the job (or tap ☎️ on the job card): the 3 things to say, the job, what was done, and when.
🔥 Say "my streak": work days in a row with bids sent, and finished jobs in a row with the paperwork out the same day. The helper cheers when you beat your record.

🛒 Store stop on the way: say "store on my way", or tap 🛒 on Today's route. It finds the hardware store that costs the fewest extra minutes before your next stop, and "what do I need today" offers it too.
🚦 The route line turns orange and red where traffic is usually slow at this hour (rush hour, midday). Google Maps still shows live traffic.
🤖 Claude's question card no longer hides under the ask bar or the Next bar.

versions.title: Friday check-in
items: 📊 Friday after 2 PM the helper offers a one-minute check-in (or say "Friday check in" any day): your week, what went well, what to do better, and one goal for next week.

🗣 On a job card, "Say hello" in Español, 中文 or Русский: the helper tells the tenant who you are and why you're there (HPD sent you for the repair) and asks to come in. If the phone has no voice for that language, it shows the words and how to add the voice.
⛑ The first time you take a before photo on a job, a quick safety check pops up: power or water off? ladder steady? "Yes, safe" is noted on the job. It doesn't stop the camera.

versions.title: Teach me the app
items: 🔎 On a job card with a before photo, tap "What do you see?": the free picture AI names the problem (leak stain, mold, broken plaster). You see it first and tap Add to put it in the job notes. Free, 30 photos a day, nothing sent unless you tap.
🎓 Say "teach me the app": a short coach at the top walks you through the app in 9 steps, the button it talks about glows yellow and the helper says what it does. Next, Back or Stop.
📷 When you open the camera for a job's first before or after photo, the helper gives one tip: step back so the whole problem shows, lights on; for the after photo, the same spot as the before.

versions.title: Goodnight from your helper
items: 🌙 After 9 PM, the first time you open the app, your helper says goodnight with tomorrow's first appointment (or the bids due), once a night.
📖 When the helper reads a job card to you (🔊), each part lights up as it reads it: the address, the work, the tenant, the dates.
🗺 The little helper riding along today's route hops and says "👋 Nice!" each time you finish a stop.

versions.title: Claude's questions, fixed; a more real voice
items: ❓ Claude's questions: the button shows how many are waiting ("6 questions"), the card shows the whole question, and the buttons fit it: ✅ Yes, do it / No when it asks yes or no (or wants exact words), 👍 You decide when there's a choice. After you answer one, the next one shows.

🗣 A voice that sounds like a real person: in 🎨 the natural voices have a ⭐. If your iPhone has none yet, 🎨 shows how to download one for free: Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Voices → English → a Premium voice (Ava, Zoe, Evan or Nathan).
🧠 Your helper now knows every open job (number, address, borough, stage, dates, amount), so it can answer about any job: the oldest in Queens, what's waiting on HPD, the biggest one.
🗣 Its voice lifts a little at the end of a question, like a person asking.

versions.title: How did it go?
items: 💬 After a job's package goes out, your helper asks "How did it go at 90th Street?". Say a few words (or tap one) and it keeps them as the job's note; say skip to leave it.
🧥 Your helper dresses for the weather: a raincoat and umbrella in rain, a winter coat, hat and scarf in snow or cold, a jacket when it's cool, a T-shirt in the heat (sunglasses when sunny).
🚗 Say "hands free day": driving mode turns on, your day is read out, and after each answer the helper says the next step. Say "go" to do it. Say "I'm parked" to stop.

versions.title: Name your helper
items: 🏷 Give your helper a name in 🎨 (like Mike). The chat shows it, and it answers to it: "Hey Mike, what's next?". Just "Hey Mike" and it says "Yes?" and listens.
🙌 It talks with its hands: it shrugs when it isn't sure, raises a finger when it lists things, and points at the buttons it offers.
🧍 When you open the chat from the dock, the helper walks in with a few steps and waves.

versions.title: The helper's mouth follows the words
items: 👄 When the helper talks, its mouth follows each word: closed on m, b and p, round on o and u, wide on e and i, open on a, like a real person.
😊 Moods: it looks proud on a day you won a job, and focused while you're at a job (after "I'm here").

versions.title: Your helper is a person now
items: 🗂 New Your papers screen (on Home): add each paper that runs out (insurance, license) with its date by typing, saying it, or a photo of the paper. The Home card turns red and warns you 30 days before one runs out. Kept on your phone only.

🧑 The helper is a person now, not a robot: face, hair, eyes that blink and follow your finger, a mouth that moves when it talks, ears that perk up when it listens, and real hands that wave, point and give a thumbs up. It smiles, frowns and naps like a person.
🎨 Pick its skin and hair in 🎨, next to the shirt color and the hat.
❓ No more lone question mark: when Claude has a question, the Claude button says "1 question" and the card shows the question with 👍 You decide, ⏭ Skip it or ✍️ Answer.
📈 The month report now opens right in the chat (it didn't open on the iPhone before).
💵 Ask "did HPD pay me for ER…": paid (how much, when), partly, or how long it's been waiting.
🕒 Say "on my way to ER…" (or "I'm on my way"): the tenant gets "on my way, about 20 minutes", with the time from where you are, after your yes.

versions.title: Retake on the spot, the month on one page
items: 📷 A dark or blurry photo is said out loud right away, with a big 📷 Retake button that opens the camera again, while you're still in the apartment.
📈 Say "month report" (or "last month's report"): jobs won and money awarded, jobs finished, bids sent, win rate, best boroughs and kinds of work, as a one-page PDF to open or 📤 share.

versions.title: A copy of everything you sent
items: 📤 "See what you sent" now shows every file of the email (the signed affidavit and invoice, the before and after photos and the videos), and "Get a copy of everything" opens the iPhone share sheet: pick Mail to send them again, or Save to Files to keep a copy. It's on the job card of a sent job and on its package page.
🧾 Ask "am I missing paperwork?": every finished job still missing photos, the affidavit or the invoice, oldest first.
🗺 Ask "where am I losing time?": your usual time on site, the slowest borough and kind of work, and one tip.
🎉 Say "good news": today's wins, bids sent, jobs finished and packages sent, with a cheer.
📸 Say "show me the before and after for ER…": the newest before and after photo side by side in the chat, with 📤 Share both.
🧠 The robot remembers the last 3 days of talk on your phone, and brings up something left open from yesterday.
🗣 When an answer takes a moment, the robot says "Let me check" first, like a person.

versions.title: A smarter robot
items: 🧠 The robot remembers what you just talked about, including its own quick answers, so you can follow up like a real chat: "why?", "and tomorrow?", "what about Queens?", "tell me more", "which one?".
⛑ It keeps answering: if the AI is busy or out of today's free allowance, a second free AI answers instead, and a failed try is tried once more by itself.
🗣 The robot talks more like a real person: short natural sentences, it reacts ("Nice, that's 3 wins this week."), uses your name now and then and asks one natural question back.
🎤 If the iPhone says the microphone is busy right after the robot spoke, the mic tries once more by itself instead of showing an error.

versions.title: The package waits for you
items: 📦 The package never sends by itself any more. Taking an after photo or video no longer opens the package: take all of them, then tap 📦 I'm done: review & send on the job card.

📋 Before it goes, the package shows a checklist: signed affidavit + invoice, before photos, after photos, before videos, after videos, with a ⚠️ on anything missing. Tap 📤 Everything's in: send package, or ➕ Not done to go back to the job.

📎 A photo or video taken after the package was sent shows on the job card ("1 video taken after it was sent: send it"). One tap puts it in the same Google Drive package folder and emails it to you, ready to forward to HPD.

👋 The robot says good morning once a day, and the Start my day card shows once. After that, when you come back it offers to pick up where you left off (the last job you had open) instead of greeting you again.

versions.title: Time at each job
items: 🎙 Smoother talking: in a conversation the chat starts listening again sooner after each answer and waits a bit longer for you before it rests.
🎙 The chat keeps listening after the robot speaks up by itself too (a new notice, a job read out loud): if you are in a conversation, just answer, no tap needed.
🌎 When a tenant texts you in Spanish, the robot says it is Spanish, tells you in English what it says, and offers your answer in Spanish (you still tap to send).

💬 Talking to the chat is smoother: if your phone cuts the mic off before it is sure you finished, the chat still answers what it heard, and after quiet moments it keeps listening a few more times before it rests.
⏱ After you tap I'm here and then save the result, the job card shows how long you were on site ("42 min on site"), and once 3 jobs are timed, your usual time too.
📸 If you drive away from a job you arrived at with no after photo and no result saved, the robot tells you once, so HPD does not reject the paperwork.

versions.title: Ideas, keep upgrading, talk to Claude
items: 💲 Price check by voice: on a bid, ask "is 3,200 too high?" and the robot says your chance to win at that price and the best price, from recent awards.
📅 Ask "what's my week look like?": the next 7 days in the chat (appointments, bids due, notices coming due), day by day.
🔔 The robot follows up once: if the most urgent notice is still open 2 hours later, its bubble asks if you want to answer it now (not at night).
🌎 Talk to it in Spanish: ask in Spanish and it answers in Spanish, with a Spanish voice when the phone has one; the mic listens in Spanish after that.
💬 After each answer the robot suggests the next question as buttons ("Which bids did I lose this month?"). One tap asks it.
📊 Ask "how am I doing?": a small chart in the chat shows bids sent and jobs won for the last 3 months.
🔍 Search everything: "find the job where the tenant said the dog bites" looks through your notes, the job cards' notes, the visit history, HPD's work descriptions and emails.
💡 One tip a day in the robot's bubble, from your own numbers (what kind of work won most, your bid pace, overdue notices).

🧠 The robot remembers you: what you tell it to remember ("I always bid door closers at 450", "Lewis wants photos first") is used in its answers, and it offers to remember things you say that are worth keeping.
📈 Ask "how am I doing?" or "is my win rate going down?": it compares the last 3 months (bids sent, jobs won, money awarded, win rate, what kind of work wins).
📩 Ask what HPD wrote ("what did Lewis say in her last email?"): it reads the full text of HPD's newest emails and tells you the part that matters.
🗣 When a question could mean two jobs or two notices, it asks you which one instead of guessing.
🧠 A much smarter robot. It now knows how the whole app works (every screen and button), so "how do I…" and "where is…" get a real answer.

🧠 It thinks with your numbers: "how many bids did I send this week?", "which notice is the oldest?", "why was ER… rejected?" go to the AI with your bids sent, this week's and this month's numbers, appointments, all jobs by stage, and any job you name in full.
🧠 It answers general questions too (repairs, materials, HPD rules in general) and gives the straight answer first. Questions no longer get grabbed by a quick list that doesn't fit.
🎯 A win gauge on every bid: type the price and the needle swings to your chance of winning (red, yellow, green).
📦 Ask "what do I need today?": the robot lists the materials for today's stops from HPD's work descriptions (paint, plaster, smoke detectors, window guards…) and how many jobs need each.
🔢 The numbers on the Jobs, Bids and 🔔 buttons count up when they change.
🚗 Bigger buttons in driving mode, easy to hit at a red light.
🔧 Fixes: the robot's bubble no longer covers the Bids list handle; the nightcap no longer causes a page error at night.

🔧 Walk me through the job: after 🔊 on a job, tap "Walk me through it" (or say it). The robot reads the work one item at a time; say "done" for the next. At the end it reminds you to take the after photos.
🕐 Say "I'm running late": the robot writes the tenant a text with your new time (from the drive, or 30 minutes), one tap to send.
🎬 A tour of what's new: after an update the robot offers it in its bubble, or say "give me a tour". Say "done" for the next, "stop" to end.
🧠 The robot learns your day: if you usually open Bids (or Notices) first in the morning, it offers that first when you tap it.
🎯 A goal ring around the robot: it fills up green as you send today's bids ("3 of 8 bids sent today") and glows gold when they're all in.
🌤 The robot dresses for the weather: an umbrella when rain or snow is coming, a scarf when it's cold, sunglasses on a hot sunny day. A nightcap when it naps, a party hat on good news.
🙋 The robot has arms: it waves when it tells you something, points at things and gives a thumbs up when something is done. ⛑ It puts on its hard hat at a job you're at.
🔋 Battery saver: in the chat tap 🎨, then 🔋. Nothing moves, so the phone lasts longer. On phones that tell the battery level, it turns on by itself under 20%.
🤖 The robot is bigger at the bottom, with a bigger face, so you can see it better.
❓ When Claude has a question for you, the robot says so in its bubble ("Claude has a question about…"). Tap the robot, then ❓ Answer Claude. The ? is now a little speech bubble by its head.
🤖 A bigger robot. Tap the 🤖 and it comes up big: a big face that rises up and bigger words while it talks with you.
🚶 The robot walks to the job. When it reads you a job or takes you there, a little robot walks across the map to that pin and waves.
😄 A little personality. A high five when you win a job, a cheer at your 1st, 5th, 10th and 20th bid of the day, and a yawn when you're up late.
👋 It says hi when you open the app (every few hours): what's waiting today, in its bubble. Tap the bubble to talk.
🤖 Tapping the robot always brings it out talking now. When Claude has a question for you, the robot says so and gives you a ❓ Answer Claude button (before, the tap jumped to Your requests).
💡 14 fresh ideas at the top of the ideas list, and the ones already built are gone from it.
🗨 The helper's speech bubble. Short news pops up in a bubble over the 🤖 without opening the chat. Tap the bubble and it reads you the rest.
🎙 Pick its voice. In the chat tap 🎨: 👩 or 👨 voices and 🐢 slower / 🐇 faster. Each tap, it says a sample.
🧭 Take me there. After the helper reads a job (🔊), say or type "take me there" and Waze opens to it. A 🧭 button comes with every reading too.
📸 It looks at your photo. Take a before or after photo and the helper says right away: looks good, or a bit dark / blurry, take another.
🔍 Weekly app check-up. Every Monday the app opens its own pages, counts the errors your phone had that week and keeps a short result. Anything it lists, Claude fixes in the next upgrade.
⚡ Quick questions in the chat. Tap ⚡ next to the chat bar and one-tap buttons appear: Today, Next bid, Notices, Owed, What's next. The helper answers without typing.
🗺 The evening note ("Today: … Tomorrow: …") no longer covers Today's route: it waits while the route is open.
⏰ Late payment warning after 30 days. In Money, a job HPD has not paid 30 days after you sent the paperwork now shows under Late, so you can follow up sooner (it used to wait 90 days).
🎨 Dress your helper. In the chat tap 🎨: pick its color (purple, blue, green, orange) and a ⛑ hard hat or a 🧢 cap. Every face wears it, the 🤖 button too.
💤 The helper naps at night. From 9 PM to 7 AM, when nothing is going on, its eyes close and a little z floats up; it wakes up with a stretch.
🗺 The helper rides along. With a route for today, a little 🤖 travels on the map from where you are to your next stop.
📣 Read it to me. Tap 🔊 on a job card or a bid and the helper reads it out loud: the address, where it stands and the work.
🌆 End-of-day line. After 6 PM the chat speaks up once with how the day went (visited, finished, no access, to close out) and how many jobs tomorrow has. Tap Open for the full Today's summary.
⚡ The app opens faster. The jobs load first and the extra lists (paid, older jobs, notice status) follow a moment later, so the map is up sooner on a slow phone.
📊 Which bids you win, by borough. The bid stats now list your win rate in each borough with a plain hint (bid lower, a little lower, or keep it).

📝 Notes on every job card. Type a note (gate code, who to ask for) and it shows the next time you open that job. What you told the chat to remember about that address shows in the same box. Kept on your phone only.

✨ The magic helper. Tap the little 🤖 at the bottom: sparkles burst out, the big robot face rises up with a glow and says hello out loud ("Good morning, Jot! You have 3 jobs to do…") while its mouth moves, then it listens.
👀 The 🤖's eyes look toward wherever you tap on the screen.
🎵 The helper has little sounds: a sparkle when it appears, a happy chirp for good news. Never at night (9 PM-7 AM) or with the sound off.
🏆 The helper cheers when the day's work is done: every bid due today sent, or no job left to do. It smiles, chirps and tells you.
🎤 Press and hold the 🤖 to talk. It listens while you hold it, like a walkie-talkie, and answers when you let go. A quick tap still opens the chat.
😊 The helper has feelings. It smiles and bounces when good news comes in (Claude finished, a win, paid) and frowns with worried eyebrows while a notice is overdue.
🔔 A tap on the shoulder. When an alert comes in, the 🤖 jumps and its antenna blinks red.
🗺 The helper points. When it names a job, a light flies from its face to that job's pin on the map and a ring pulses there.

🤖 One helper that comes alive. Tap the 🤖 in the middle of the bottom row and it grows up into the talking helper: a big face that talks, listens and blinks. Close the chat and it pops back into the button, working again. 📋 in the chat opens Your requests (a question from Claude still opens straight to it).

💬 Tenant answers in the chat. When a tenant texts back without a day and time, the helper pops up, reads it out loud and offers an answer (Send it? one tap, then yes). A day and time still becomes the appointment offer.
📋 What is left for each job. On a finished job the card lists the photos, the affidavit and the invoice, shows which are done, and the Next button opens the first one missing.

🗣 The helper speaks up by itself. A new 24/72-hour notice pops up from its talking face with ✍️ Answer, and so do bids due within the hour, "looks like you're driving", HPD answered and an appointment not confirmed.
✨ More movement everywhere. Answers appear word by word, buttons spring when you press them, ideas and lists slide in one by one, and the chat glides up.

🤖 Your helper has a face now. It blinks and looks around, tilts its head while Claude works, its ears light up while it listens, and its mouth moves while it talks to you. It's on the 🤖 Claude button, at the top of the chat, and on the Claude line on the map.

📏 Claude on the map is one slim line now. It shows what it's doing this second, a moving bar and the %, so the map stays clear. Tap the line for the whole card (💬 talk, steps, notes); ▴ makes it one line again.

💬 The chat moves to the side by itself. 15 seconds after an answer (or tap ⇥) it becomes a small bubble with the helper's face on the right. It comes back up by itself with its next answer; tap the bubble any time.
✨ The bottom buttons come alive. The job folder gives a small shake now and then and the red numbers bob. Turned off if your iPhone is set to reduce motion.

💡 6 new ideas in 💡 Ideas. The chat speaks up by itself, a morning plan in 20 seconds, the chat asks the next step, a picture of Claude's change, tenant answers in the chat, a price coach on every bid.

👋 Tap Bids and it says hello. It tells you how many invitations still need a price (due today, due tomorrow) and which one is next. ▶ Start flies the map to that building and opens HPD's work description; 🎯 Bid all in a row goes through every one, and after each send it moves to the next one by itself. Later hides it.

📸 Photo check on the job card. Once a job has before or after photos, a box under them checks every photo and says "All 4 photos look good for HPD", or which ones are blurry, too dark or washed out (with the picture), or that the before or after photo is missing. It runs on your phone: free, nothing uploaded.

🌤 Straight answers. Ask "should I do a roof job tomorrow?" (or paint, gutters, outside work) and the chat answers yes, no, or "only early, rain from 2 PM" first, then asks if you want to open your list. Questions to the AI also get the answer first; what it would open is offered as a button.
🤖 Next no longer runs into the Claude card. Next sits on one line just above the chat bar. × hides the card and leaves a small "🤖 Claude working · 50% Show" tab: tap it to bring the card back.

💡 Ideas any time. The 💡 at the left of the chat bar opens Claude's ideas and "Ask Claude for more ideas". 🔁 Keep upgrading now shows ON ✓ or OFF in big letters at the top of Your requests, and a 🔁 sits on the 🤖 Claude button while it's on.
💬 "More ideas" is now in the All menu, always one tap away. It asks Claude for new ideas, and five new ones were added to the list.

🧠 The chat remembers: say "remember the super at 123 Main is in the basement" and it keeps the note on your phone only. Say "my notes" to hear them, and when you ask it to read that job it tells you what you said.
🌙 Quiet hours: no phone alerts from 9 PM to 7 AM. 24-hour notices and emergencies still ring. Anything else that comes in at night is held and sent at 7 AM.
🔁 Keep upgrading now shows proof: under the switch it says the last upgrade Claude built on its own and how many it did today (of 3). Six new ideas were added to the 💡 list.
📸 Photo check: when you add before or after photos, the app tells you if one is too dark or blurry, so you can retake it before HPD rejects it. The check happens on your phone only.

🔠 Bigger words switch: tap More at the bottom, then Bigger words. Every word in the app gets about 20% bigger, for reading in the truck or in the sun. Tap again to go back. It stays the way you set it.

💡 Ideas from Claude: tap 🤖 Claude (or All > Upgrade ideas) and the top of the screen lists Claude's next upgrade ideas. Tap 👍 Do it and Claude builds it; Not now hides one; 💬 Ask Claude for more ideas. Or just tell the chat "give me ideas", then "do idea 2" or "more ideas".

🔁 Keep upgrading on its own: switch it on under 💡 Ideas (or say "keep upgrading on"). When you have no requests open, Claude builds the next idea by itself, up to 3 a day, tests it, puts it live and tells you. Your requests always go first.
💬 Talk to Claude while it works: tap 💬 on the Claude card on the map for Stop for now, Do this one first, Looks good, or type your own words. It goes to the request Claude is building.
🔔 Your phone now also tells you when Claude starts a request and when it's live to try, not only when it's done.
🗺 Tidier map top on the phone: weather and street cleaning on one line.
🛠 Fixed: two requests sent in the same second (like 👍 and then "more ideas") could overwrite each other. Each one is kept now.

versions.title: Claude in the middle, live every few seconds
items: 🤖 The middle button at the bottom is now Claude (it was a second ✨ AI button that did the same as the chat bar's 🎙). It turns green and says Working while Claude builds something, shows ❓ when Claude needs your answer, and is grey when the office computer is off. Tap it for your requests.

⚡ See what Claude is doing right now: the card on the map says the step it's on ("Changing the screen", "Testing on my computer", "Sending it live"), with the seconds counting, and the steps it just finished. It updates by itself every few seconds while Claude works. Ask the chat "what's Claude doing?" any time.
🅿️ "No ASP" now says it in plain words: "No street cleaning · park free".

versions.title: Ask the app what changed
items: 💵 Ask the chat "how much will HPD pay me this month?" (or "money forecast"): it adds up what PIP still owes you, takes out what rejections are holding, and says what HPD usually pays you in a month. It says it is a guess, and points you to the rejections to fix.

📷 Read a photo: tap 📷 in the helper and take a picture of a notice, invoice, work order or the work. It says what it is, the job number, dates, amounts and what to do next, with the job's card to tap. Signed in only; the photo isn't kept; up to 15 a day so it stays free.

🚗 Driving mode: say "I'm driving" (or tap 🚗 in the helper; it also offers itself when the phone moves at driving speed). Answers are said short, the whole answer stays on screen in big letters, and it keeps listening so you never touch the phone. Say "I'm parked" to stop.

💰 On an open bid say "bid the usual" (or "same as last time"): it fills your usual price for that kind of work, the middle of your last 3 bids on it, says which bids it came from, and saves it. Send is still your two taps.

🤔 The chat understands you better: if a word is misheard or mistyped ("wats next", "reed me the new bits") it does what you meant; if it isn't sure, it asks "Did you mean…?" with buttons to tap, or 🤖 Ask the AI instead.

👋 Back in the app after 2 hours or more? One line over the chat says what came in while you were away: new bids, HPD emails, what Claude finished or asked. Tap Tell me, or ask "what did I miss?" any time.

💬 The chat's "Try:" buttons now follow what you just asked: after the weather it offers "should I do the roof job today", after bids "next bid" and "what should I bid", after money "which rejections do I have". One tap, like saying it.
📰 Ask the chat "what's new?" (or "what did you upgrade?") and it reads you the newest changes out loud, with 📋 All the changes to see the whole list.

versions.title: A chat on the map
items: ⚡ Upgrades now reach your phone about 15 minutes sooner (a quick check, then live, then the long tests). And the 🤖 Claude card on the map sits under the other notes instead of on top of "⚠ jobs need a check", so both can be tapped.
🗣 Tried Claude's upgrade? Just say it in the chat: "it works" (👍, off the map) or "not right, the button is still too small" (Claude goes back to work on it).
▶ A finished request now has ▶ Try it (opens the screen that changed), 👍 Works (you checked it; it leaves the map) and ↩ Not right? (tell Claude what to fix).

❓ When Claude asks you a question about a request, answer it right there: Your requests has a box under the question (➤ Send to Claude), or just say "tell Claude …" in the chat. Not happy with a finished one? Tap ↩ Not right? Tell Claude. For something new while Claude waits, say "tell Claude new request …".

✅ When Claude finishes one of your requests, or needs your answer, your phone gets an alert even with the app closed: "✅ Claude finished your request" or "❓ Claude needs your answer". Tap it and Your requests opens. With the app open you see it and hear it within a few seconds.

🛠️ When something breaks on your phone, Claude now gets a short note about it by itself (no names or phone numbers), so it gets fixed without you having to explain it. If a screen ever crashes, you see "This screen hit a problem" with ↻ Try again and 🗺 Back to the map instead of a blank page.

🤖 Ask the chat "what's Claude doing?" (or "status of my request"): the answer stays live, with the steps done, what it is doing now and the last note, and changes by itself while you watch (green Live dot).
🔢 The cards in the chat are numbered now: say or type "open number 2" (or "take me to the third one") to open that one. "The second one" still reads it to you.

🎙 The chat bar's mic is always there now. If your phone doesn't let the app listen by itself (Chrome on iPhone does that), the 🎙 opens the keyboard: tap the 🎙 at the bottom of the keyboard, talk, then ➤, and I answer out loud.
🔥 A job glowing "Asked" on the Notices map (HPD asked about it, nothing sent since) now says so on its card too, with the outcomes to make the affidavit and ✉ Reply.
🔊 A speaker button on the chat bar shows whether I say my answers out loud. 🔇 means silent; tap it to turn the voice back on.
⚡ While Claude works on your request, the card shows what it is doing right now ("Running the tests", "Pushing it live") with a seconds counter, and checks for news every 3 seconds.
🧭 Today's route: the red Clear route button now sits at the top of the panel and stays there while you scroll the stops.
🎙 The helper's typing box now has its own mic: tap it, say it, and I answer (it glows red while listening; tap again to stop).

🃏 The chat's answers now come with cards you can tap: a bid (with your saved price, or the best price from what wins, and 💰 Price), a notice (with ✍️ Answer), a job (with its appointment time). One tap opens it.

⏰ The chat speaks up by itself, right above the bar, when something matters: bids due within the hour ("1 bid due in 30 min, 1 not priced. Start?" ▶ Start opens it), HPD answered one of your notices (Open), or an appointment in the next 3 hours the tenant hasn't confirmed (📱 Text them). Tap ✕ and it won't bring that one up again.
✨ A chat bar is now always on the map, right above the bottom buttons: type anything (or tap 🎤 to talk) without opening anything first.

🗺 The chat moves the map: "show me the bids in Brooklyn" or "today's bids in Queens" shows only those pins (tap 📍 Brooklyn ✕ on top to see them all again); "next bid" opens the next bid to price, map first, and says how many are left; "bid 450" fills the price (sending is still your two taps).
📍 "Where's my 2 PM?" or "where's my next appointment?" opens that job on the map with Waze and Google Maps.
💬 Today's conversation stays on your phone until midnight: tap ▲ Earlier today in the chat to scroll back.

versions.title: Each bid: map first, then HPD's page
items: 📍 While the map moves, the card on top also says what the job is and when it is due ("door · tomorrow 11:00 AM").

🗺 Opening a bid (from the list, the checklist, Next bid, or after you send) moves the map there first, with the borough and address on top ("📍 Queens · 47-46 40 STREET"), then opens HPD's job description page full screen, zoomed in on the work. Close it to price the bid.
📄 Some invitations type the work on page 2 and leave page 3 empty (ER09499): the app now reads and shows page 2 for those. A long job that goes on to page 4 still shows both pages (Next ›).
💰 On HPD's full-screen page: "Price it" at the bottom closes the page and puts the cursor in the price box, keyboard up.
▶ New "Next ▶" button at the top of every bid card: goes to the next bid still to price or send (by deadline), map first, and says how many are left.
🔘 Don't want it? Tap "🗺 Opening a bid: map first…" on the bid card to turn it off.

versions.title: Building pictures stay free
items: 🖼 The job card keeps Google's building picture, with a counter on it: "Free pictures this month: N of 9,000" (all your devices together).
🛑 At 9,000 the app stops loading pictures until the 1st (Google gives 10,000 free a month), so there's never a bill. The 🔄 360° view always works, it's free.
🔒 Also set in your Google Cloud: at most 300 pictures a day, and an email alert at $2.50 / $4.50 / $5.

versions.title: Glowing buttons, Claude's clock, affidavit sent once
items: ✨ Jobs, Bids and Notices glow softly when something there needs you: a 2nd try due or a job to close out, a bid due today not sent, a notice overdue or under 6 hours. Nothing waiting: no glow.
⏱ While Claude works on your request, a clock counts up every second next to the moving bar ("working for 3:12"), on the map card and in Your requests.

📄 Affidavit from the job card: open the job, Work completed (or what happened), Save, and it makes, emails and files itself. Opening it again later never sends it a second time: it shows as sent, with Revise for a real change.

versions.title: See Claude working, live
items: 🟢 What's new → Your requests says whether Claude is ON right now (checking for requests every 20 seconds) or OFF, with when it was last on. No more guessing how many minutes.
⏸ Claude runs on the office computer: it picks up requests while that computer is on with the Claude app open (7 AM to 11 PM). When it's off, the 🤖 card on the map says so instead of "starting soon".
📊 Each request shows a big percent, a moving bar while Claude works, and the step being done right now. The list refreshes by itself every 15 seconds while it's open.

versions.title: Affidavit straight from the job card
items: 📄 Tap the affidavit / package button on the job card: it goes straight to making it. Your saved signature and the notary's saved signature go on by themselves, no taps.
📁 Two copies go to your Google Drive by themselves: the signed digital copy and the unsigned copy to print.

📧 The signed package is emailed to you (only you) to review and forward: the affidavit and invoice, plus the before/after photos and videos when the job has them, otherwise just the affidavit and invoice.
✍️ A phone with no saved signatures asks you and the notary to sign once; after that it's automatic. Corrections are still signed in ink.

versions.title: Payments: every job until it's paid
items: 💵 HPD notices → Procurement → 💰 To get paid now starts with every job whose paperwork went to HPD: sent date, days waiting, and what PIP shows (open, paid).
⏰ Late first: jobs PIP still shows open more than 90 days after you sent the paperwork, with the amount, so you know whom to call at HPD procurement. Tap one to open the job.
❔ Jobs sent after PIP's last download, or not in PIP's download at all, are never called late: the screen says how many, and a fresh Agreement Summary from PIP fills them in.
📈 Paid in the last 30 days are listed too.

versions.title: Your rates on the phone and the computer
items: ☁️ Your rates (My price), your minimums and your costs now follow you: set them on the iPhone and the computer has them, change them on the computer and the phone gets the change.
🔒 Kept in one private file in your own Google Drive (like your saved signatures), never published. The newest change of each one wins, a removal too.
📱 Not connected to Google on a device? Bids → Stats → Costs & rates says they stay on that device only.

versions.title: One fax for several bids
items: 📠 Two or more bids with a price saved and not sent? The Bid checklist shows "Send N saved bids in one fax". Tick the ones to send (up to 6), tap Send, then tap again: one fax to HPD (212) 863-8655.

📋 The first page lists every OMO with its address and price and asks HPD to log each one under its own OMO (HPD once missed a bid that came inside a fax titled with another job). Each bid's own package follows, in that order.
✓ Each bid is then tracked on its own: fax going through, then confirmed by HumbleFax's one answer for that fax. If the fax fails, each bid is resent by itself as usual.
✏️ A revised price still goes in its own fax (the old price is crossed out on it).

versions.title: Corrections: dates from what you sent
items: 📨 Fix & resend fills in the dates from the paperwork you already sent HPD (your Sent mail): work dates, access tries and calls, refusal or done-by-others day. Now 42 rejected jobs have them, up from 32 (the rest have no affidavit in your Sent mail: faxed, or sent another way).
🔄 New rejections get their dates by themselves: the app reads your Sent mail for them every half hour (newest first). A job with nothing found is looked at again after 2 weeks.
✅ It still says where the dates came from ("Dates filled in from the paperwork you sent HPD on ..."), and you check them against HPD's reason before you save.

versions.title: Say the outcome; 2nd tries on the route
items: 🎤 Say it: "refused access on EQ15239 yesterday, male, tall, dark hair". The helper reads it back with the day and who refused; say yes and it's saved on that day, then the package (affidavit + invoice) opens.
📅 Any day works: yesterday, 3 days ago, Monday, 10/24, October 24. Leave it out and it's today. Forgot who refused? It asks you.
🔒 No access 2nd tries: from the day the 2nd try is allowed (72 hours after the 1st) the job is on Today's route, marked 🔒 2nd try: knock again.
🔔 And a phone alert at 10 AM that day: 2nd try due, with the address. Weekends ring Monday 10 AM.

versions.title: Job card: change the outcome or date
items: ✏️ Saved the wrong outcome or date? The job card's Outcome step has Change outcome or date. It opens with what you saved (the date, and who refused), so you change just what's wrong and Save.
🔁 Switch to another outcome (for example Refused access to Done by others); No access starts again at the 1st try. Cancel keeps what was saved.
🔒 Once the package is made, change it on the paperwork with Revise paperwork, as before.

versions.title: Job card: just the affidavit
items: 📝 New box at the top of the job card: Just the affidavit? Pick what happened (Refused access, No access, Done by others, Work completed) without tapping I have arrived or Start visit.
⛔ It asks only what that outcome needs: the date (today or a past day), and for Refused access who refused. Save, and Make the package is the next step (the affidavit and the invoice together).
🚪 Arriving to do the work is the same as before: I have arrived, then Start visit.

versions.title: Refused access: just the date and who
items: ⛔ On the job card, Refused access now asks only 2 things: the date (today, or pick the past day it happened) and the person who refused (one tap for Male, tall, dark hair). Then Save.
📅 Every outcome asks its date the same way: Work completed (date finished), No access (date you were there), Done by others (date found done).
🛠 Fixed: opening the paperwork from the job card reset the date to today, so a past refusal date never reached the affidavit. Now the date you picked stays.

🧾 The affidavit screen shows one Refused access card: 1. Date refused, 2. Person who refused. Name, relationship and phone are folded away (they print DID NOT PROVIDE / SUPER if blank). The invoice is made with the affidavit on the same date, and the Invoice Date box shows that date.

versions.title: Change any affidavit date + Claude live
items: 📅 Refused access and Work completed by others now have a date box right on the card. Pick any date from the calendar, a past day too, any time before you send. Before, it was only a small text box hidden under More details.

🧾 Fixed: with a past refusal date, the invoice start stayed on today, so the package stopped ("start date is after the completed date"). Now the affidavit and the invoice (invoice date, start, completed) all use the date you pick.

✏️ No Access (1st and 2nd attempt) and Work completed (started and completed) dates can be changed too. After the paperwork is sent to HPD it locks; tap Revise paperwork and every date opens up again.

🤖 Claude live: when you send Claude a request (by talking to the AI or in What's new), a card on the map shows it live: working on it now, the steps (2/5), the step being done, and the latest note with how long ago.
🔄 It checks for news every 20 seconds while a request is open. × hides it until the next note; tap it to see all your requests.

versions.title: The log says what each text was
items: 🛠 Fixed: every text was written on the job as "Texted the tenant the job summary", even an "On the way" or "15 min late" text.
📝 Now the job card records what it was: the job summary, on the way, running late, we're outside, asked to confirm, asked about tomorrow, or a message in your own words.
📋 The shared contact record shows the same, so it's the truth. Names and phone numbers are still never saved on the log.

versions.title: Tenant status on the route
items: 🗺 Each stop on Today's route now shows the tenant: ✅ reached, 🟡 not reached (an access attempt), 🔴 not contacted yet (call first), or 🏢 public area.
🛠 Fixed: a stop added from the job card or by voice now always shows on the route. Before, opening the route panel could plan a new route over it.

versions.title: Route by voice
items: 🎤 Say "add this job to my route" or "put EQ15239 on today's route" and the AI adds it to the end of Today's route. It tells you which stop it is.
➖ Say "take it off my route" (or "remove EQ15239 from my route") to drop a stop.
🧭 "This job" means the card you have open. You can also say the job number or the address.

versions.title: Go anyway after 3 tries
items: 📍 If a tenant isn't reached after 3 calls or texts over 2 days or more, the tenant box says to go anyway for the 1st access attempt. No Access needs 2 visits 72 hours apart, so the clock starts with that visit.
➕ One tap, "Add to Today's route", puts the job on today's route. If there's no route yet, it starts one for today (8 AM to 5 PM).
✅ Then the box shows "On Today's route".

versions.title: Share the contact record
items: 📋 Each job's tenant box has a "Share contact record" button. It puts every call, text, reply and appointment on that job in one list, with the date and time, oldest first.
✉️ It opens your phone's share sheet (Mail, Messages, Notes), so you can paste the record into a reply when HPD or vendor tracking asks if you reached the tenant.
🔒 It shows the HPD work order number and address. It doesn't add the tenant's phone number.

versions.title: Today's calling score
items: 📊 Jobs now shows how today is going: "Today: 6 calls / texts · 2 reached", right above the Tenant not reached yet button.
📞 Every call (answered or not) and every text from the app counts, by New York time. It starts at zero each morning.

versions.title: "Next tenant" by voice
items: 🎤 Say "next tenant" (or "start calling", "call the next tenant", "who's next to call") and the AI opens the next tenant who hasn't been reached yet.
🗣 It tells you the address and how many are left, and what to do: text the job summary first, or tap Call.
📞 It's the same order as Start calling and the Next tenant button, so the whole calling round works hands-free.

versions.title: Start calling
items: ▶ In Jobs, tap "📞 Tenant not reached yet" and a green "Start calling" button shows up next to it. It opens the first tenant to call.
➡️ From there, each job's "Next tenant to call" button takes you to the next one, so you go down the whole list without going back.
📅 Fixed: the order is now truly the oldest due date first, for every date format HPD uses.

versions.title: Next tenant to call
items: ➡️ After you log a call or a text on a job, a blue "Next tenant to call" button shows up in the tenant box. It shows how many are left and the next job number and address.
📞 One tap opens that job, so you can call tenants one after another without going back to the list. It's the same idea as the next bid opening after a NO BID.
⏱ It picks to-do jobs with a tenant phone that nobody has reached yet, oldest due date first. Jobs you already tried in the last 3 hours wait their turn.

versions.title: First text = first contact
items: 📱 On a job nobody has contacted yet, the big button is now "First: text the job summary". Call sits right next to it.
✍️ The text is professional and short: who we are, that NYC HPD assigned us, the HPD work order number, and a short summary of the work (not every detail). Then it asks for a good day and time.

📝 The job card writes down what was sent: "Texted the tenant the job summary: ..." with the date and time. That is the first record of contact. The automatic text on a new award is written down the same way.
📅 Once you reach the tenant, the box shows "Reached: book the visit" and opens the appointment. After you book it, the box shows the day and time and whether it is confirmed.

versions.title: Who still needs a call
items: 📞 The Jobs list shows the tenant on every to-do job: 🔴 Call the tenant first, 🟡 Not reached yet (how many tries), ✅ Tenant reached, or 🏢 Public area.
🔴 New button on the Jobs list: "Tenant not reached yet" shows only those jobs, so you can call them one after another.
🏢 Public hallway / common area jobs say "no tenant to call" instead of asking you to call. If you do call someone from the job, it is still logged.
🧭 The job tracker now counts calls: no answer says call again, talked says book a time.

versions.title: Tenant first
items: 📞 Calling the tenant is now the first thing on every job card, right under the address: a big green Call button and a Text button.

📝 Every contact stays on the job for good: the call is written down the moment you tap Call (even with no answer), then tap No answer, Voicemail or Talked. Texts sent from the app, the tenant's replies and appointments are written down too. Newest first, on every phone.
🚦 The box says where you stand: 🔴 not contacted yet, 🟡 not reached yet (how many tries), ✅ reached and when.
🚫 After you fax a NO BID, the next bid opens by itself, the same as after sending a bid. Tap Come back to see the NO BID again.

versions.title: Cleaner bottom
items: 🧹 Fewer buttons at the bottom: just Jobs, Bids, ✨ AI, Notices and All. Tap All for big round tiles: Route, Appts, Follow-up, Stats, Alerts and What's new. The rest of the map is clear.

versions.title: New bottom dock
items: 🔘 Real round buttons: Route, Appts, Follow-up, Stats, Jobs, Bids, Notices and More now look like the Map and Locate buttons, each with its own color and a white label. They lift and glow when you point at them and press in when you tap. The bell glows when a notice is due soon.
👆 Drag the map and the bottom buttons slide out of the way so you see the whole map. Let go and they come right back.

🔀 Pick your bottom buttons: press and hold Jobs, Bids or Notices (or More → Bottom buttons) and choose what goes there, like Follow-up or Route. The others move to the row above. Your phone remembers it.
🫧 The bottom is see-through now: no black bar, the map shows behind the buttons.
📱 New layout: the main buttons are now along the bottom like an iPhone app: Jobs, Bids, ✨ AI, Notices and More. Above them, swipe sideways for Route, Appts, Follow-up, Stats, Alerts and What's new.
☰ More shows everything with what's waiting in it (bids due today, overdue follow-ups, notices…) plus Weather, Parking, Year and dates, Map style and Where am I.
🌤 The weather and 🅿️ parking now sit at the top left with the other messages, so they never cover a job banner.

🅿️ No street cleaning today? A green "No ASP" chip shows next to the weather on the map (Sundays and holidays). And with your location on, the Next pill says how many minutes away the job is (🚗 14 min).

versions.title: Reminder the evening before
items: 🌆 Wrap up the day now also tells you tomorrow's weather and whether alternate side parking is on tomorrow.
🌧 Rain heads-up: when rain or snow is coming today and your route has roof or outside work, an alert tells you which job to do first (once a day).
🌤 Weather on the map: the temperature now and when rain or snow starts (or today's high and low), bottom left above the AI. Tap it for the full forecast and tips for the work (your request).
🏢 Every job card now shows the building: year built, floors, walk-up or elevator, apartments, and open HPD violations (with the ones like your job), before you get there.

🗣 A better AI voice: it picks the most natural voice on your phone, says numbers like a person ("58 degrees", no emoji), and a 🔇 Stop button hushes it. Pick the voice and speed under Alerts → Phone alerts.
🅿️ Ask "is alternate side on today?": it knows the city's 2026 parking calendar (holidays, meters, the next day off).
🛠 "Where's the nearest Home Depot?" (or Lowe's, hardware store, plumbing supply, gas station) opens Waze to the closest one.
🏢 "How old is this building?": year built, floors, apartments, walk-up or elevator, and open HPD violations, from the city's records.
🚗 "How long to the next job?": drive time from where you are (more in rush hour), with Waze for live traffic.
☀️ Start my day now includes the weather (rain, freezing, wind, dark early) and alternate side parking when it's off.

🌦 The AI knows the weather and traffic: ask "what's the weather", "is it going to rain tomorrow" or "how's the traffic". It says what it means for the jobs (rain on roof work, freezing, wind, when it gets dark) and opens live traffic in Waze.
📊 Stats count up: your money and job numbers roll up when you open My stats.
👉 The job that needs you now glows on the map with a "Next" tag: the same one the Next pill at the bottom points to.
🤖 Claude's progress comes to you: when Claude works on something you asked for, a "🤖 Claude: Working on it" alert pops up with the latest note; tap it to see Your requests.
✨ Your AI is on the map: tap the glowing AI button (bottom left) and just talk. It tells you the most pressing thing first and keeps the conversation going (your request).
🎬 Slower, smoother zoom: opening a job glides in over about 2½ seconds and closing glides back out, with no jump at the end, so you can see where you are going.

👉 The helper suggests what to say next: under each answer, one-tap ideas that fit where you are (on a job: read it, take me there, text the tenant; on the map: what's next, today, tomorrow's reminders).
🗺️ Smoother map: jobs glide in and out slowly, and when you pick a route the other pins fade so the route stands out (your request).

🤖 Smarter helper: say or type anything. Say "tell Claude to…" (or "I want the app to…") and it goes straight to Claude as an upgrade request. Tap ⌨️ to type, your conversation stays on screen, and 💡 shows the most pressing thing before you ask.
🎙️ Ask "what's next?": the helper tells you the next thing to do (same as the pill on the map) with a ▶ Do it button.
📝 After an appointment ends with nothing recorded, the Next pill reminds you to record what happened (one tap opens the job).
❔ Appointment later today still not confirmed? The map's Next pill offers a one-tap text asking the tenant to confirm.
✅ Tenant texted back YES? Tap "Tenant confirmed" on the appointment, or say "the tenant confirmed". The appointment turns confirmed.
🆕 After every upgrade the app now shows this card: "New update includes…" with what changed. Tap Got it to close it.
🎙️ Say "remind tomorrow's tenants": tomorrow's appointments with a 📅 Text reminder button for each tenant not reminded yet.
📅 In the evening (3-9 PM) the map's Next pill offers a one-tap reminder text to tomorrow's tenants: "we will see you tomorrow 10-11 AM… Reply YES to confirm".

versions.title: Street View picture off
items: ⏱ Running late to an appointment? The map's Next pill offers a one-tap text to the tenant: "running about 15 minutes late".
🏢 The Street View building picture is back on job cards. The app's own automatic checks no longer load it, which was the main source of paid Google calls.
💵 Ask "how much did I get paid this month?" (or last month, this year): HPD's payments from PIP, compared with the month or year before.
📞 After you call a tenant from the app, "How did the call go?" pops up: No answer / Voicemail / Talked. One tap notes it, and No answer reminds you to call again tomorrow.
💬 One-tap messages to the tenant on the job card: On the way, 15 min late, Tomorrow?, Please confirm, We're outside.
📆 The money screen and the helper say when PIP's numbers are from, and warn when they're over a week old (PIP is brought in from its exports, not read by itself).
🚪 When you arrive at a job, one tap texts the tenant "we're outside, please let us in".
🚚 When the helper gives you directions, a third button texts the tenant "we're on the way".

versions.title: Rejections by voice
items: 🔧 Ask "which rejections do I have?": what HPD's rejections are holding, the biggest to fix first, with Fix buttons that open each correction.
▶ From "which rejections do I have?", tap "Fix them one by one" to go through every correction in order.

versions.title: 🧭 Job tracker
items: 🧭 Job tracker (Map menu, or say "show my job tracker"): every job by stage from the award to the money (text the tenant, waiting, appointment, paperwork, sent, waiting for payment, paid), with counts. Tap a stage to see its jobs, tap a job to open it.
☀️ Mornings: the first time you open the app, "Start my day" reads your day out loud and plans your route in one tap.
📊 Ask "how did I do this week?": jobs won, bids sent, jobs finished, paperwork sent and money paid, in one answer.
📅 Your phone alerts you about an hour before each appointment, even with the app closed.
👤 Job cards show the tenant step: texted, replied or appointment set, and what to do next.
📱 In the job tracker, tap 📱 next to a job to text its tenant right away.
⚡ Upgrades reach your phone faster (the checks before each update run three at a time).
🎤📱 With the text service on, say "text the tenant for EQ15239": it reads you the text, and "yes" sends it.
💬📅 When a tenant texts back a day and time, the app offers it as the appointment; one Yes saves it and texts them the confirmation.
🗣📱 Say "tell the tenant we'll be there at 10": your words go to the tenant (the one who texted last, or the job you name), after your yes.
❓ Not sure what to say? Tap ❓ in the helper (or ask "what can you do?") for examples you can tap.
📞 Ask "which tenants haven't answered?": the tenants you texted who didn't reply, oldest first, with Call buttons.
🤖 Autopilot (Map menu): see what runs by itself, how to connect texting, and a switch for the automatic first text to tenants on new awards.
💡 With a bid open, tap 🎤 and ask "what should I bid?": the recommended price and how often it would have won.
▶ The pill at the bottom of the map now shows your next thing to do (bids due today, a tenant who replied, paperwork to make) when no notice is urgent. Tap it to go.
🌆 Evenings: "How did today go?" in one tap (or ask "how did I do today?"), plus the bids coming up.
📞 After a call, say "I called the tenant, no answer" (or what they said): it's noted on the job, and it reminds you to call again tomorrow or offers the appointment.
👤 Each job card lists every contact with the tenant (texts, replies, calls, appointments), newest first.
🚫 With a bid open, say "no bid, too far": the reason is picked out for you; one tap confirms.
🧭 The job tracker opens on the last 30 days of awards; tap "All" for every job.
📅 Ask "what appointments do I have?" (or today / tomorrow): times, addresses and Waze buttons.
💬 Ask "any texts from tenants?": their latest replies with the job (once texting is connected).

versions.title: Award and paid alerts · texts from the app · glide to the job
items: 💰 New award alert says where and what: "You won ER… · <address>" and the work in plain words.
💵 Paid alerts: "HPD paid you $…" and "Paid · ER… $…" when PIP shows the money.
📱 Text service ready: once your Twilio number is set up, "📤 Send it now" texts the tenant from the business number, their replies come into the app, and new awards get the first text by themselves.
🗺 Tap a job: the map glides in to the building. Close it: it glides back out to where you were.
💵 Ask "how much does HPD owe me?": the total in PIP, the biggest jobs, what rejections hold up and the last payment.
🧠 The AI remembers the last few things you said, so you can follow up with "that one" or "text them".
🧭 Ask "what's left on ER05729?": everything done on the job from award to payment, and what's left, in one answer.
🔔 Alerts list grouped by day (Today, Yesterday…), and "🔊 Read them to me" reads your new alerts out loud.

versions.title: Talk to it: appointments, reminders, actions
items: 📅 Say "make an appointment for EQ15239 Thursday at 10". After your yes it's saved on the job, with a ready text to the tenant (you press Send) and Add to Calendar.
⏰ Say "remind me to call Lewis at 3". The app rings and says it at 3, and Add to Calendar reminds you even with the app closed.
🧠 Say it your way: the AI understands free sentences and does the app's actions for you (route, text the tenant, open a job, paperwork, notices), always asking before saving or sending.
🗺 Your award-to-payment autopilot idea (texts, AI calls, booking, payment alerts) is written up in the plan with costs and what's needed.

versions.title: Your route flows on by itself
items: 🎤 Bid by voice: open a bid, tap the 🎤 next to the price and say "bid 500". The price is filled and saved; you still tap Send twice.
📅 The days menu shows how many jobs each choice has (Last 15 days, 30 days… This year), and the 📅 button shows how many jobs are on the map now.
➡️ Finished a job on today's route and the paperwork is approved? "Going to the next stop… in 8s": the map glides to the next stop and opens it. Tap "Stay here" to stay, or "Go now".
🗺 "Open next job" glides there too, so you see where it is.
📨 The slim bids bar fits small phones: the count and "today" always show.

versions.title: Vendor board as a conversation · more map · next bid by itself
items: 💬 Vendor tracking board: every notice reads like a conversation: their notice on the left, your reply, paperwork and send on the right, their answer below.
✔ Each step says how the app knows: "Verified: found in your sent email" with the date and time, "Made in the app", or "Marked by you" (not found in email yet).
📎 The PDF you sent is named in the 📤 message; tap "See what you sent" to open the actual file from your email.
🟡 Anything new since you last looked is ringed in yellow with NEW.
🗺 More map: the bids header is one slim line. All / Today / Tomorrow open from the 📅 button and hide by themselves.
🔔 Alerts are bigger and clearer: what kind, the whole message, a blue Open and a big OK.
➡️ After you send a bid, the map glides to the next bid due and opens it. Tap "↩ Come back" or say "come back" to return to the one you just sent.
➡️ Notices flow too: after you send a reply, the board moves to the next notice to answer and starts its reply (you still tap Send twice). "↩ Back to" returns to the one you just answered.
📠 After a bid is sent, the "sent · Come back" bar now sits inside the next bid's card, so an alert can't cover it.

versions.title: Affidavits: sign once, notary one tap, right form every time
items: ✍️ Your signature is saved in your own Google Drive (private), so the Home Screen app, Chrome and a new phone all put it on by themselves. No more "sign again".
🧾 A saved notary is one tap: "✓ Notary …: I witnessed the signing · approve". The package builds and goes out right after. Change the notary, name or date under one button.
📄 Every job shows which affidavit it needs: "Earlier HPD affidavit (Rev. 01.21.2025)" if awarded before Aug 28, 2026, otherwise "New HPD affidavit". It is picked from the award date only.
🖋️ Corrections are still signed by hand in ink, with the notary's real stamp.

versions.title: Keep talking · back to the bids map · fax resends by itself
items: 💬 Keep talking: tap it in the helper's panel and just talk. It answers out loud, then listens again by itself. Say "stop" (or tap ✕) to end.
🧠 It remembers the list it just gave: after "what did I win this week", say "read me the descriptions", "the first one" or "number two".
📠 Bids: after Send, the app goes back to the bids map by itself with "📠 ER… sent to HPD · $…". Tap the bid any time to follow the fax.

🔁 A bid fax that doesn't go through is sent again by itself (same price, next HPD line, up to 3 times before the deadline) and you're just told: no Snooze box. The red box shows only when it can't resend by itself.
🔊 Sounds and the voice play even with the iPhone's silent switch on.
🎤 If the iPhone blocks listening, the helper says how to allow it; you can also use the keyboard's 🎙 in the search box and tap Go.

versions.title: A smarter helper
items: 🎤 Ask several things at once: "How many jobs did I win today and what bids are due tomorrow?" — both answered, one after the other (up to 4).
🎤 Say it your way: sentences that aren't a command ("anything new from Gafur", "did HPD give me any work") go to the AI, which now also knows your wins this week and HPD's emails of the last 3 days.
"How many jobs did I win today, read me the description" reads each win. If none yet today, it tells you the last one, including wins that only came by email so far.

versions.title: Answer notices and do paperwork by voice
items: 🎤 "Answer the notice for E R 0 1 9 8 7" / "Reply to Lewis" / "Reply to Gafur": the vendor tracking board opens on that notice with the AI writing the reply. Read it, then Send (two taps, as always).
🎤 "Do the paperwork for this job" / "Send the package for EQ17776": a button opens that job's affidavit and invoice page.

versions.title: Plan my day by voice
items: 🎤 "Plan my day" (or "build my route", "where should I go first"): the app plans Today's route (overdue jobs, appointments and 2nd tries first, close together) and reads it out: "Your day: 8 stops. First 1207 1st Avenue, then 2090 1st Avenue…". Then say "take me to the next stop" for Waze / Google.

versions.title: Sign in right from the map
items: 🔑 When the phone is signed out, a Sign in with Google bar shows at the top of the map (it goes away once you're signed in). The job card's tenant line has the same button.

versions.title: Do more by voice
items: 🎤 "Text the tenant" (the job on screen, or "…for EQ15239"): the AI writes the text on the job card; you open it in Messages and press Send.
🎤 "Call the tenant": shows their name, number and a 📞 Call button.
🎤 "Take me to the next stop" (Today's route, else the closest open job) / "Navigate to 707 East 189": Waze and Google Maps buttons for that job.
🎤 "I'm here" / "Start the job": the job on screen, or the one you're standing at; it asks, and yes saves your arrival.
🎤 "Open job E R 0 8 2 8 3": opens its card.

versions.title: Stay signed in for a year
items: 🔑 One Google sign-in now lasts a year on the phone and renews by itself while you use the app (it was 30 days). Sign in once from the Home Screen app and you stay in.
🤖 If you ask the 🎤 a question while signed out, it says the AI is on and shows Sign in with Google right there; the tenant text says so too.

versions.title: Text the tenant
items: 📱 Job card → Tenant → Text tenant: the AI writes a short, friendly text (who you are, the job in plain words, asking for a good time). Read it, change anything, tap Open in Messages and press Send there. The app never sends it by itself.

The card then shows "Texted <time> · Waiting for their answer" and a They replied button. If they replied, or there's no visit / appointment by the next morning, the Call button lights up and your phone reminds you: "📞 Call the tenant at <address>".
🤖 The AI is switched on for the app (Cloudflare Workers AI), for free questions to the 🎤 helper and for the tenant texts.

versions.title: Search without signing in · your wins read out · privacy fix
items: 🔍 The search box works before you sign in (job #, address, a few words). Signed in, results also show tenant names and phones.
🏆 "Which jobs did I win today, read me the description" (even when the phone hears "want" instead of "won"): "You won 3 jobs today. 1: 108-62 45 Avenue, hinges, 1 door…".

🔒 Tenant names and phones are kept only in the app (signed in). A few had slipped into public files (HPD's award list and an old job backup): those are masked or removed now, and a check runs on every update so it can't happen again.

versions.title: Ask the helper anything · your wins
items: 🏆 "Which jobs have I won today?" / "What did I win this week?" / "Any awards yesterday?": the helper reads HPD's Confirmation of award emails (same day) and HPD's award list and tells you the jobs and addresses.

💬 Any other question ("which bid is the easiest to win today?", "what does Gafur still need from me?") goes to the AI with what the app knows (notices, open bids, money held, jobs, today's route; never tenant details). It answers in a few spoken sentences and can't change or send anything.
Saying "yes" works from the search mic too (within 2 minutes of the question).
The search results list now opens below the All / MN / BK / QN… buttons instead of under them.

versions.title: Sign in works from the Home Screen app
items: 🔑 On the iPhone Home Screen app, Google's sign-in opens in a separate sheet that kept the sign-in to itself, so the app couldn't open your HPD emails (the board showed 0). Now the app hands Google a one-time code and picks the sign-in up when you come back: sign in once from the board's Sign in with Google (or Storage) and you're in.

versions.title: Board says when you are signed out
items: 🔒 When the Google sign-in on the phone runs out, the vendor tracking board says "Your HPD emails didn't open" with a Sign in with Google button (it brings you back to the board), instead of showing 0 everywhere.

versions.title: Talk to the app
items: 🎤 The mic in the search box is your helper now. Say a search ("mini split") and it searches; say what happened and it answers out loud:

"I finished ER01987" / "I finished this job" (the card on screen) / "no access at 707 East 189" / "the tenant refused" / "we did part of the job": it reads the job back and asks. Nothing is saved until you say yes or tap ✅ Yes, save it.

"Read me this job": the job in plain words, then HPD's text. "Read me the new bids": how many are open, and the first few in a few words (borough, what, when due). "What do I have today?": overdue notices, bids due today, route stops, jobs to do. "Which notices are open?"
Typing works too: type the sentence in the search box and press Go.
⏰ Urgent alerts ring once, then stay on screen quietly until you choose (no more ringing every 30 seconds). Phone alerts for an overdue notice come once, not every 2 hours.

versions.title: Have you arrived? · The job first
items: 📍 With the app open, when you're within about 120 m of a stop on Today's route (or a job you started driving to today), it asks "You're at <address>. Have you arrived?" Tap ✅ Yes, start the job: the job opens with your arrival saved (time + GPS). It asks once per job, and checks again when you come back from Waze / Google.
📋 The job card starts with the job in plain words (what, how much, where in the building), HPD's full text below. 🔊 Read aloud reads the summary first.

versions.title: No duplicate buttons
items: One way to Today's route: the round Route button (the bar at the bottom is gone). The appointments button is now called Appts.
Job card: Waze and Google once. The "next job" box has Open next job → (its own Waze / Google are on its card). The route list doesn't repeat the next stop's Waze / Google either.
The overdue chip steps aside while the red alert box shows the same notice.
Urgent box: ✓ I handled it (two taps) for a notice you took care of another way (a call…): it stops ringing here and the phone reminders stop.
Voice: invitations to bid are just counted, no work order: "New invitation to bid" or "You have 3 new invitations to bid". Several at once come as one phone alert.

versions.title: Say it to search
items: 🎤 Tap the mic in the search box and say the job: "mini split", "Bedford Avenue", or the job number letter by letter ("E R 0 8 2 8 3"). The matching jobs show right away.
Your last searches show as chips when you tap the empty search box; ✕ clears the search.
Fixed: the Jobs, Alerts, Invoice and Payments pages no longer flash / redraw when the day changes after an update.

versions.title: Find any job · Save and Send by the price · voice catch-up
items: 🔍 Type a job number, part of an address, or a few words from the job ("mini split", "fire escape ladder", "boiler") in the map's search box: every matching job shows (yours, open bids, past invitations, HPD's awards) with the words that matched. Tap one of yours to open its card; an open bid opens the bid; anything else shows HPD's description, the 📍 map and the 📄 invitation.
🧾 Bids: the price, 💾 Save and 📠 Send sit together at the bottom of the bid screen, always in reach. Send still takes two taps; the package fills itself after Save.
🔊 Alerts that came while the phone was locked: open the app and tap "Play N new alerts" to hear them (iPhone only speaks after a tap).

versions.title: Alerts that talk
items: 🗣 While the app is open, every alert plays its tone and then says what it is: "Urgent email. 24-hour notice from Lewis, work order E Q 3 1 3 6 4. They want the affidavit and invoice.", "New invitation to bid…", "Confirmation of award! You won…", "Request from Gafur, requesting documents…".

📋 HPD emails are summarized: which work orders they want and what ("Missing documents for 15 work orders: EP27489 affidavit and invoice…", "They want a status update on ER06498: the completion date has passed", "Incomplete invoice on ER01919"). The banner and the phone alert show this instead of the subject.
With the phone locked, iPhone plays its own alert sound; the alert's text has the same words.
Alerts page: 🗣 Voice on / off, and a button to hear each kind of alert.

versions.title: Vendor tracking: To send / Sent / They replied
