items: The board has three tabs: 📝 To send (nothing sent yet), 📤 Sent · waiting (sent, waiting on them, with the date and days waiting), 💬 They replied (they wrote back after your last email).
Hit Send and the job moves to 📤 Sent right away; a note at the top says where it went.

Gafur's lists: the app reads your sent emails for PDFs named with the job ("EO32701 AFF INVOICE.pdf"), in her thread or any other. Those jobs show 📎 Already emailed <date>, and the list email says sent on that date, so nothing is sent twice.
Her "Received." right after a PDF confirms that job only; your note to the whole list ("I will send everything today") no longer counts as sent for every job.
Photo requests aren't marked sent by an old affidavit PDF.

versions.title: Jobs: the list and the map together
items: 🧰 Jobs opens in the lower half; the map above shows only the jobs of the tab you are on (To do, Close out, 2nd try, Waiting, All) and zooms to fit them.
🗺 Map folds the list down to its tabs so you see the whole map; ☰ List brings it back.
Tap a pin or a job: its card opens. Close the card and the list comes back on the same tab.

versions.title: Friday money report
items: 💵 Every Friday from 2 PM your phone gets one alert: what HPD owes you in PIP, what got paid this week, how many rejections are holding money up (the same numbers as 💰 To get paid), and the job owed the longest.
Tap it to open 💰 To get paid.
If the PIP numbers are more than a week old, it reminds you to download the new summaries so the totals stay right.

versions.title: Jobs is a round button like the others
items: 🧰 Jobs (bottom left) is round with its count, like Route, Bids and Notices. Close out and 2nd try are tabs inside it now (with the 📄 Package link on each close-out job), so the map has one button there instead of three.
The focus chip (⏰ the most urgent notice) is smaller.

versions.title: Calm map: only the most urgent moves
items: No more glowing and blinking everywhere: notice pins, bid pins, appointments and the Notices button stand still with a steady colored ring (red = overdue / 24 h, orange = soon, blue = fax going through).
Only the single most urgent notice job breathes slowly on the map (overdue first).
A chip at the bottom names it — "⏰ ER01987 overdue 5 h →" — tap it and the board opens on that job.

versions.title: 🔨 Jobs button + alerts you can't miss
items: 🔨 Jobs (bottom left, with Close out / 2nd try): every open job — To do (late ones first, "Nd late" / "due M/D"), Close out, 2nd try, Waiting on HPD, All — with a search. Tap a job: the map goes there and its card opens. Jobs HPD closed or PIP paid are left out.
An overdue notice or a failed fax now opens a red box in the middle of the screen (Answer now / Snooze 30 min) that rings again every 30 seconds until you choose.
The HPD Field icon on your Home Screen shows the number of unread alerts, like Gmail.

versions.title: 🌆 Evening wrap-up on your phone
items: Every weekday from about 6 PM, one alert closing out the day: bids faxed (confirmed / waiting / failed), NO BIDs, notices and requests you answered, what's still open, and tomorrow's bids still to send (with the first deadline).
Goes with the ☀️ morning briefing at 8 AM.

versions.title: ☀️ Morning briefing on your phone
items: Every weekday from about 8 AM, one alert with your day: bids due today (and the first time), notices overdue or due within 24 h, documents requests to send, payment rejections to fix.
Tap it and the app opens on today's summary. A quiet day says "nothing urgent today".

versions.title: 📠 Live fax tracker + more life when you tap
items: Under Send: Package ready → Sent to HumbleFax → Faxing HPD (the line it went to) → HPD received. The current step spins, finished steps turn green with a moving line between them.
When HumbleFax confirms, a big ✓ pops with confetti. A failed fax turns red and shakes (and is sent again by itself).
"Tap again" buttons pulse; sent replies pop green; map buttons press in when tapped; badge numbers pop when they change.

versions.title: Alerts open their own job
items: Tap a phone alert, a banner or an item in 🔔: a notice or request opens the vendor tracking board scrolled to that job (outlined in yellow); a new invitation opens that bid; a rejection or a win opens the job's card.

versions.title: ⏰ Overdue notices keep reminding you
items: A 24/72-hour notice that's overdue with nothing sent alerts your phone again every 2 hours (weekdays 8 AM – 8 PM) until it's answered: "⏰ ER01987: notice overdue 2 h — answer now".
Banners in the app step aside by themselves (20 seconds) so they never sit on a Close button; every alert stays in 🔔.

versions.title: Moving 'sending' signs + alerts check themselves
items: While a bid or NO BID fax is sending, the button shows a spinning ring and moving stripes (Sending the fax to HPD…); a fax going through spins on its pin, chip and checklist row; email checks, replies and opening sent PDFs spin too.
Phone alerts: every time the app opens the phone checks the server really has it and registers again if not. The Alerts page says ✓ The server has this phone (or Fix it now).

versions.title: 🔔 Phone alerts are automatic
items: No sign-in needed: once the iPhone allows alerts, the phone registers itself, and again every time the app opens (so it fixes itself).
If alerts were never allowed, the map shows one Allow alerts button (Apple needs that one tap); after that it's automatic.
Alerts on a phone that isn't signed in show the kind, the job and who (not the email subject).

versions.title: 🔔 Notifications: every alert, kept to track
items: 🔔 next to Filters on the map (and on the bids screen) shows how many are new. Tap it for every alert, newest first.
Tabs: 💰 Won · ⏱ Notices · 📋 Requests · 💵 Rejections · 📩 Messages · 🧾 Bids · 📠 Faxes · ⏰ Deadlines · ✓ Handled.
Tap one to go straight there (it's marked read); ✓ marks it handled; Mark all read.

versions.title: A different alert for each kind (and cha-ching!)
items: 💰 You won a job: cha-ching. ⏱ 24/72-hour notice: a siren. 📋 Documents request (Gafur, Lewis): two soft notes. 💵 Payment rejected: a falling tone. 📩 Message from HPD: two notes up. 🧾 New invitation: a double ping. ✅ / ❌ fax, ⏰ deadline.
Each email is read for what it is: a status update or correction from Lewis or Gafur is a request, a payment rejection is a rejection, a confirmation of award is a win.
The phone alerts say the same (💰 You won · EQ…!, ⏱ 24-hour notice · …, 📋 Deoranie Gafur replied · …).
Hear every sound on the Alerts page.

versions.title: 📱 Phone alerts (even with the app closed)
items: Alerts page (⚠️ on the map) → 🔔 Turn on phone alerts → Allow.
On the iPhone it works in the app on your Home Screen (Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen, then open HPD Field from the icon).
You get an alert when HPD writes or replies (with who), a new invitation to bid comes in, or a 24-hour notice drops under 6 hours, even with the phone locked. Checked every 10 minutes.
Tap the alert and the app opens there. Send a test alert / Turn off on the same page.

versions.title: ⚠️ Old-job date check
items: Making paperwork for a job awarded months ago with a work date long after it (like EP27382: awarded 5/21/2025, dated 2026) now stops and asks: Was the work really done then?
Use HPD's dates fills HPD's start / complete-by dates in one tap; These dates are right lets your dates through.
Nothing is made until you pick one. Corrections keep the dates you already sent.

versions.title: 🔔 A ring for every notification
items: Rings and a banner when HPD writes or replies (with who it's from, e.g. Deoranie Gafur), when a new invitation to bid comes in, when a bid or NO BID fax goes through or fails, and when a 24-hour notice drops under 6 hours.

A different tone for each: two notes for an email, a rising tone for a fax that went through, a low tone for a failed fax, a double ping for a new invitation, three beeps for a notice running out of time.
Tap the banner to go straight there. 🔔 / 🔕 on the banner turns the sound on or off.
Fixed: on the iPhone the sound stopped after the app had been in the background; now every touch keeps it working.
The app has to be open to ring (a ring with the phone locked needs phone notifications: ask for it).

versions.title: 📄 See what you sent
items: When Found on record says the paperwork was sent, tap 📄 See what you sent: the emails you sent for that job (date, to whom) with their PDFs, read from your Gmail.
Tap a PDF and its pages open right there (tap a page for full screen, pinch to zoom). Open in Gmail opens the email itself.
On the vendor tracking board and on the priority card of a job.

versions.title: 🚫 No bid now fills the form and faxes HPD
items: Tap 🚫 No bid and pick why: the invitation is filled in right away with NO BID where the price goes (page 1, page total and bid amount), company, signature and date like a bid.
📄 Open the NO BID form to look at it, then 📠 Fax NO BID to HPD (two taps). The cover says you won't be bidding; your reason stays private.
HumbleFax's answer is checked every minute: ✅ confirmed, or ❌ failed with the backup lines to send it again. Every phone sees it.

versions.title: No more flashing
items: The app was reloading itself every time new data came in (about every 10 minutes), closing the panel you had open and redrawing the map.
Now it only reloads for a real app update, and only when nothing is open. New bids, notices and emails still show up by themselves.

versions.title: Zoom only the job pages
items: The app no longer zooms in when you pinch or double-tap by accident.

HPD's pages (invitations and notices) and your paperwork preview zoom by themselves in full screen: pinch, or double-tap to zoom in and back out; drag to move. 🔍 still works. The map still pinch-zooms.

versions.title: Better job pictures on the bid map
items: Each pin is a bold white drawing on its own color (blue drop for leaks, purple lock, violet hinges, brown door, pink roller for painting...), so you can tell jobs apart at a glance.
The ring and the day tag show when it's due; the red ! is only on a failed fax now.

versions.title: ⏰ No answer? Ask them to confirm
items: When you've sent the paperwork to vendor tracking and they haven't confirmed in 5 days, the card turns orange: "No answer in 9 days" with ⏰ Ask them to confirm.
The follow-up is already written (job, address, the date you sent it, "please confirm you received them"). Two taps send it, like every email.
⏰ Ask N to confirm writes all of them on one screen. After you ask, that card waits 5 more days before asking again.
Right now all 11 waiting notices went out 10/16-10/19, so they'll start showing on Oct 21-24.

versions.title: 🗓 Notice deadlines skip City holidays
items: 24 / 72-hour notices are never due on a New York City holiday (Columbus Day, Election Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year's and the rest), the same as weekends.
A 24-hour notice on the day before a holiday is due first thing (10 AM) the next working day: Friday before Columbus Day -> Tuesday 10 AM; Wednesday before Thanksgiving -> Friday 10 AM.
Each open card on the vendor tracking board now shows the exact due time, and names the holiday that was not counted.

versions.title: 🔧 Fix payment rejections one by one
items: HPD notices -> 💵 Procurement -> 💰 To get paid -> 🔧 Fix them one by one (26 · $4,720): opens the first rejection with Auto-fix and the preview.
Accept it, then Next: <OMO> -> opens the next one right away. "Fixing one by one · 5 of 26" shows where you are.
Jobs that need your real work dates first (2024-25 jobs) show Skip, so you can do the quick ones first and come back.

versions.title: Bigger bids panel with charts
items: Tapping Mine, Stats or History opens the panel half-way up the screen (bigger than before); pull it up for the whole screen, pull it down or tap 🗺 Map to hide it.
Mine starts with charts: your bids by result (won / lost / waiting on HPD / saved, not sent) and bids sent per week for 8 weeks (the green part is what you won).
Stats -> Wins & prices: the win rate by month now has a bar for each month. Bigger tabs and words in the list.

versions.title: Notices update by themselves, with a chime
items: The app now picks up your emails with HPD by itself: every 5 minutes while it is open, and each time you come back to it. No more "Couldn't check your email": if the phone can't read Gmail, it uses the app's own email reader (it reads your email every 10 minutes) and says how fresh it is.
Both ways: your replies move notices to 📤 Sent; HPD's answers move them to ✅ Confirmed. Answered notices leave the Priority map.

📩 A new email from HPD rings a short chime and shows a banner at the top (tap it to open the board). 🔔 / 🔕 on the banner turns the sound on or off. On iPhone the sound works after you've tapped the app once; it can't ring while the app is closed.
The Notices picker no longer covers the Bids / Map / Locate buttons.

versions.title: Bids: Stats in pages, with daily progress
items: Bids -> Stats now has 3 pages instead of one long scroll: 📈 Progress, 🏆 Wins & prices, 🧾 Costs & rates.

📈 Progress: today at a glance (due, priced, sent, confirmed, failed, to go, with a progress bar) and the last 7 days (received, sent, confirmed, failed, won, $ bid, with bars per day), plus your all-time win rate.
The tabs (Open, Mine, Stats, History) are at the top; today's checklist and Start bidding show only under Open, so the other pages start clean.

versions.title: Bigger bid pins you can see on the iPhone
items: Each bid pin is now a big white circle with the job picture (🔩 💧 🚪 🔒 🪟...), a thick ring in the due color (red today, orange soon, yellow later, green sent, blue fax going through) and the day in a bold tag under it.
Status as a corner badge: ✓ sent, ⏳ fax going through, ! due today and not sent (it pulses), $ easy win, 🚫 no bid.
Tap a pin: it pops, and the bid opens.

versions.title: 🔁 Failed bid faxes are resent by themselves
items: When HumbleFax says a bid fax failed, the app sends it again by itself (same price you approved) to HPD's next fax line: (212) 863-8655 -> 863-7804 -> 863-7805. Once per failure, up to 3 times, only before the bid is due. Then it checks HumbleFax's answer every minute and turns green when confirmed.
It works while the app is open on a phone or computer (it needs your Google sign-in). The bid's log says each automatic send.
A failed fax also shows 🔁 Resend now: one tap, no need to refill the package first. The backup line buttons work right away too.

versions.title: Bid pins show the kind of job; Gafur (AEP) on her own
items: Bids map: each pin now shows a picture of the job (🔩 hinges, 💧 leak, 🚪 door / closer, 🔒 lock, 🔐 Secure Tech, 🪟 window, 🚰 plumbing, 🧱 plaster, 🟫 floor...) with the due day under it. The list rows show the same picture.
Notices: 📋 Gafur · AEP has its own button on the map picker and its own filter on the Vendor tracking board.

Board -> Gafur · AEP -> ✉ Answer the whole list in one email: one line per job with what is on record (e.g. EP27450 affidavit and invoice sent on 10/8) or "update:" for you to fill in. Send to me first, or Send with two taps (it won't send while an update line is empty).

versions.title: 🔄 Check my emails now: the board updates from what you sent
items: Your replies to Lewis this morning are in: 13 notices you answered with PDFs now show 📤 Sent · waiting on them.

Vendor tracking board -> 🔄 Check my emails now: reads your sent emails and HPD's answers (last 7 days) and updates the steps right away, then lists which notices changed (e.g. ER01987 📤 Sent, waiting on them).
Opening the board checks by itself (at most every 10 minutes). It only reads subjects and dates, never sends anything.

versions.title: Revise paperwork works on the iPhone
items: Revise paperwork did nothing on the iPhone (the app blocks pop-up boxes). Now it opens on the page: pick why (✅ It was completed, 🔁 Got access later, 🚫 Refused access, 🚪 No access, 📅 Wrong dates), add a note, tap Revise twice. The sent version is kept in the job's record and the paperwork switches to the new outcome (e.g. Work Completed) for you to put the dates and check the preview.
Archive, Change outcome, Approve return visit and Reset test job had the same problem: they now take two taps on the button instead of a pop-up.

versions.title: 🔎 A head start on every notice
items: Every notice on the Vendor tracking board (and the PRIORITY card when you tap a glowing pin) now shows what the app already has for that job, with dates: affidavit & invoice sent (date, files), paperwork made, PDFs you emailed them, the outcome (work completed / refused access / no access with both tries / completed by others), visits, when the work was due, HPD closed, PIP paid or open, a payment rejection.
Then the next step and its button: 📤 send the paperwork again (it went out on <date>), 📄 make it (e.g. refused access on 10/10), or ✨ write an update when nothing is on record.
The AI reply gets these facts too, so it can say exactly what was sent and when.

versions.title: 24-hour notices from Friday are due Monday morning
items: Deadlines now count weekdays only. A 24-hour notice that comes in on Friday (or over the weekend) is due first thing Monday (10 AM). Monday-Thursday ones are due 24 hours later. A 72-hour one from Friday is due Wednesday.
The board, the Priority timers on the map, the morning summary and the red Notices reminder all use this.

versions.title: Corrections highlighted on the copy HPD gets; Notices pulses when time is short
items: The corrected affidavit and invoice emailed to HPD now starts with a cover page: COPY - CORRECTED PAPERWORK, the OMO, HPD's rejection, and each change in yellow (old -> new). Every page says COPY at the top. The original you print and sign in ink stays clean.
Print folder: 👁 See the copy HPD gets, to look at it before you email it.
When a 24 / 72-hour notice has under 6 hours left (or is overdue) and nothing is sent, the Notices button pulses red with a tag (e.g. ⏱ 10 <6h) instead of a banner over the map.
Morning summary says OVERDUE when a deadline has passed.

versions.title: ☀️ Morning summary on the map
items: The first time you open the app each day, a card on the map says what needs doing today:
⏱ notices due today (and the first deadline) · 📋 missing-documents requests (and how long they have waited) · 💵 money held by rejections (to fix / in the mail) · 🧾 bids due today.
Tap a line to go straight there (the board on that filter, 💰 To get paid, or the bids). Got it closes it for the day; ☀️ Today in Notices opens it again.

versions.title: Notices take you to the map; reply to many at once
items: Notices -> Priority (or any kind): the picker shrinks to a thin bar at the bottom and the map zooms to fit those jobs, so you see them right away. Change ▴ opens the picker again; List opens the list; ✕ goes back to all jobs.
Vendor tracking board -> ✉ Reply to many at once: every reply already written on one screen (Paperwork on record / No paperwork yet / All). Read and fix each one, then Send (two taps) one by one.
📨 Send all to me first: all the replies in one email to yourself, to read them over before anything goes to HPD.

versions.title: 💰 Rejections tracked until HPD pays
items: HPD notices -> 💵 Procurement -> 💰 To get paid: every payment rejection until the money comes in: ❗ rejected -> ✏️ fixed -> 🖨 printed & signed -> ✉ copy emailed -> 📮 original mailed -> 💵 paid in PIP.
At the top: how much money the rejections are holding up, how many to fix, how many are in the mail, and what was paid after a rejection (last 90 days).
Biggest money first. Each one shows the next thing to do: ✨ Auto-fix, the print folder step, or waiting for HPD to pay.
On the map, Payment rejected shows $ held, and each pin shows its dollars (e.g. 💵 $570). Jobs PIP has no record of yet say Not in PIP yet.
Paid ticks by itself from PIP. HPD closing a job with $0 paid is listed at the bottom to dispute.

versions.title: Vendor tracking board: Gafur's missing documents added
items: The board is now the Vendor tracking board: the 24 / 72-hour notices AND every job on a missing-documents list (Gafur), one card per job.
Filter at the top: All · ⏱ 24 / 72-hour · 📋 Missing documents.
Each missing-documents card says what they want (Affidavit and Invoice, photos, update / documents), how many days they have been waiting, and when they followed up.
Same 4 steps and buttons: AI reply, make the paperwork, send it to them with the PDF, confirmed. A reply or PDFs about another job on the list don't count for this one.

versions.title: 📤 Send the paperwork to vendor tracking from the board
items: On the board, pick what happened (Work completed, Refused access...) or tap 📤 Send the paperwork: the paperwork page opens for that job.
When the package is made, a box at the top says "Send to vendor tracking: <their name and email>" with a ready message. The signed copy is attached.
Send to me first, or 📤 Send with the PDF (two taps). The board then shows 📤 Sent · waiting for them to confirm.
Their email address is never put in the page address.

versions.title: ✨ AI-written replies on the 24 / 72-hour board
items: On the board, ✨ Reply (AI): the AI writes the reply from their notice and the facts on record (paperwork sent on <date>, made, deadline). It is told never to make anything up.
Tell the AI what to add (e.g. "we went back Friday") and tap Write again.
You read and edit it; Send to me first, or Send with two taps. The AI never sends anything.
Until AI is switched on for the app, the ready-made reply is used and the box says so.

versions.title: Bigger and clearer on the iPhone; everything pops when you touch it
items: Bigger map buttons with bigger names (Route, Today, Stats, Notices...), bigger borough buttons (All, MN, BK, QN, BX, SI) and the 📅 days button.
Bigger words on the notices picker, the 24 / 72-hour board, the Priority box and the timers on the map.
Every button and link pops up for a moment when your finger touches it.
On a short screen (Safari with its bars) the map buttons stay a little smaller so all 9 still fit.

versions.title: ⏱ 24 / 72-hour board
items: Notices -> ⏱ 24 / 72-hour board: every poor performance notice from vendor tracking (last 30 days) with a big countdown.

Each one has 4 steps: ✉ Reply sent -> 📄 Paperwork made -> 📤 Sent to vendor tracking -> ✅ Confirmed. They tick by themselves from your emails (your reply, your email with the PDFs, their answer) and the paperwork on record. Tap a step to tick it by hand.
✉ Reply (ready): a reply that says what is true for that job (paperwork sent on <date>, ready today, or on it). Edit it, Send to me first, or Send with two taps.
Under 6 hours left and nothing sent: a red reminder on the map opens the board.
Confirmed ones (or jobs HPD closed / PIP paid) move to Done.

versions.title: Notices on the map: everything at once, Priority glows with its timer
items: Tap 📩 Notices: every notice job is on the map at once, glowing in its color: 🔥 Priority (orange, red for 24-hour), 💵 Payment rejected (green), ✏️ Corrections (yellow), 🖨 Print & mail (purple).
A small picker at the bottom narrows it: All notices · Priority · Payment rejected · Corrections · Print & mail · The list. The Priority button shows the nearest deadline (⏱ hours left).
Each Priority pin shows its timer ("24h · 19h left"). Tap it: the card says PRIORITY with the hours left, what Lewis / Gafur want, and whether paperwork was already sent.

On that card, pick what happened (Work completed, Refused access, No access, Completed by others, Partly done / going back): the affidavit opens with that outcome so you put the date, check it and make the copy + original.
Priority and Vendor tracking are the same thing now (Lewis / Gafur asking for the affidavit and invoice).

versions.title: Notices split: Procurement vs Vendor tracking; days in one small menu; icons pop
items: HPD notices now has two separate boxes. 💵 Procurement (they pay you: the job is done, the invoice was sent, and they rejected the invoice / affidavit): Rejected, Corrections, Print & mail.
📋 Vendor tracking (Lewis / Gafur asking for documents or an update): Due now, Requests, Messages. The two are never mixed.
The 30 / 60 / 90 days, Custom and 2024-25 buttons are gone from the map. One small 📅 button next to SI opens them all: 15, 30, 45, 60, 90 days, this year, all dates, custom dates, 2024-25 jobs.
The borough buttons (All, MN, BK, QN, BX, SI) and the map buttons pop up when you point at them or tap them.

versions.title: Reply to Lewis / Gafur from the Priority list
items: Each poor performance notice and missing-documents item has ✉ Reply: a ready message (paperwork sent on <date>, or the affidavit and invoice will follow) to their @hpd.nyc.gov address. Edit it, Send to me first, or Send with two taps.

versions.title: Priority list of what HPD is waiting on
items: HPD notices opens on 🔥 Priority: everything HPD is waiting on, most urgent first: Lewis's 24-hour and 72-hour notices with a countdown, rejected paperwork, missing documents, fixed paperwork to print and mail.
Each item says who asked, what for, and whether paperwork was already sent, with buttons to open the job, make the paperwork, see the email, and mark it handled.
Kept apart: 💵 Payment rejected, 📋 Vendor tracking (affidavit and invoice requests), ✏️ Corrections.

versions.title: Recommended price and bigger buttons
items: Next to the price box: the recommended price with its chance to win (and My price if your rates cover the job). Tap Use, or type your own: the price is always your choice.
Bigger map buttons on taller screens; each glows in its color, pops when tapped and glows stronger while pressed.

versions.title: Bid form filled in when it opens
items: Opening an invitation fills in the bid form for you: company, owner, address, phone, fax, dates and the job description. The price stays blank for you to type (no automatic price).
Typing your price and tapping Save makes the final bid document right away, ready to review and send.

versions.title: Bids count on the map
items: The Bids button always shows how many invitations are open, like Notices: red when some are due today, blue otherwise.

versions.title: Your costs and profit on every bid
items: Bids → Stats → Your costs: what each kind of work costs you (materials and labor) plus the trip. Starts with your numbers: hollow metal door $500, hinges $15 each, door closer $30, Secure Tech lock $1,000, electric strike $150.
Every bid now shows your cost and your profit (and %) at your price and at the market's best price, and which parts still have no cost.

versions.title: Requests checked every 5 minutes
items: Claude checks your requests every 5 minutes (7 AM to 11 PM) while the Claude app is open on the computer.
When you save a request it says Received right away and when Claude will start.

versions.title: Progress counter on every request
items: Each request shows a progress bar with its steps (e.g. 2 of 5 steps · 40%) and a green light while Claude is working on it.
An hourly check reads your new requests and posts progress here.

versions.title: Progress reports on your requests
items: Your requests from Ask for a change show here with their status (Received, Working on it, Done) and my progress notes: what happened and what changed.
The version at the bottom of the map says when there is a new update for you.

versions.title: Bid calculator and version on screen
items: Bid calculator on every invitation: the whole job laid out (what, where, floor, locations), then your price line by line from your rates plus extras (floors up, more locations, borough), next to the best price and its chance to win. Adjust any line or the total and it recalculates.
The version and update time are at the bottom of the map; tap it to see what changed. After an update the app says so.

versions.title: Rejections fixed, print folder, emails to HPD
items: Rejected paperwork: Auto-fix & preview fixes it from HPD's reason and shows every change; Accept saves it to the print folder, Reject deletes it.
Print folder: each fixed rejection with its steps (fixed, printed, copy emailed, original mailed) and dates.
Email a copy of the fixed paperwork to whoever signed HPD's notice, after you see the email; Send to me first sends it to your own Gmail.
HPD notices in tabs: Rejected, Corrections, Requests, Messages, Print folder.
Every email thread with HPD staff kept and shown as a chat, the ones waiting on you first.

versions.title: Bids screen
items: Bids open on the map; pull the list up halfway or all the way.
No bid, with a reason, on every invitation.
The invitation card shows the building's picture, jump buttons and every page of HPD's invitation.
The Job summary: what the work is, square feet, doors, parts and where.
My price from your own rates; your minimum per kind of work; a warning when a price is far above the best price.
Secure Tech locks and electric strikes are priced on their own.

versions.title: Map
items: Every map button opens its screen and closes the others; a second tap closes it.
Close out and 2nd try are round buttons; their lists show every job.
Buttons no longer hide behind Today's route on smaller iPhones.
